results.description:
The prodigal daughter returns to the mountains...

The last thing Natalie Roche wants to do is return home. She has her life, her independence, and her rock-and-roll dream job: a talent manager in L.A., at the world's largest music management firm. But when her grandmother dies and leaves her the family house in Appalachian Maryland, she's faced with a choice: confront her past, or lose it completely.

No one could blame her for indulging in a one-night stand to relieve the stress… until the brown-eyed bombshell from the bar turns out to be the lawyer handling her family's estate.

Now she's fighting the rules and fighting her feelings, and Natalie has more than just her inheritance at stake. Nothing back home is how she remembers: not the neighbors, not her family, and she's struggling to keep up with all the new developments. Between the demands of her overbearing boss, her family's secrets, and the weight of her past, will she capsize under the pressure? Or will her new-found friendships teach her what makes a house a home?

Buy Betting on the House and find where you belong today!

Betting on the House is a bisexual homecoming story with themes of found family, small town life, and a sprinkling of spice. It is the first book of the stand-alone Fixer Upper Romance series.
